sounds.author: Work With Sounds / Werstas (sound recordist: Leena Ahonen), provided to Wikimedia Commons via Wikimedia Sverige
sounds.originalFile: WWS_Chainsaw.ogg (Wikimedia Commons original, 96 kHz stereo Vorbis)

sounds.notes: Professionally recorded Stihl MS 150C idle (small 23.6 cm3 two-stroke), fairly clean. Fundamental: Comb 43-46 Hz (~2,700 rpm); strongest partial ~229 Hz (5th harmonic). Loop built from source 2.42-4.52 s with an equal-power 60 ms crossfade (correlation 0.55); starts at an upward zero crossing, no edge fades (would dip at the seam).

sounds.notes: Stihl MS 150C sustained high throttle, clean comb with mild load wobble. Fundamental: Firing freq ~169 Hz (~10,100 rpm), ACF and strongest partial agree; a 1/3 sub-harmonic (~56.5 Hz) is present. Loop built from source 34.12-36.15 s with an equal-power 100 ms crossfade (correlation 0.985); starts at an upward zero crossing, no edge fades (would dip at the seam).
